messages:
Maya (docs): Quick PR opened to: update Optimize migration guide (quant profiles), refresh Python+JS snippets, and add a short checklist for KV/cache heavy evals. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3472
Ravi (eng-opt): Nice. Can you include an explicit fallback table for q4_0 -> q4_1 and mention perf differences on >8k tokens?
Maya (docs): Added a fallback row and a sentence: "q4_0 reduces memory but may degrade fidelity on long contexts (>8k). Use q4_1 as fallback for longer contexts." Will push in a sec.
Sven (runtime): Heads up: the JS SDK snippet currently suggests passing latency_target directly; that's misleading — it's a server routing hint only. Please update both snippets.
Maya (docs): Good catch. Editing now.
Juno (devex): Can you paste the updated JS and Python examples here so I can lint them quickly?
Maya (docs): Python:
```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
profile = {"quant": "q4_0", "batching": {"max_batch": 6}}
resp = client.optimize.run_model("redwood/fast-llama", input="Summarize this long doc...", profile=profile)
print(resp.output)
```
JS:
```javascript
import { OptimizeClient } from 'redwood'
const client = new OptimizeClient()
const profile = { quant: 'q4_0', batching: { maxBatch: 6 } }
const resp = await client.optimize.runModel('redwood/fast-llama', { input: 'Summarize...', profile })
console.log(resp.output)
```
Sven (runtime): LGTM. Also add a one-liner reminding users to "run evals with representative long prompts and KV-cache heavy workloads" in migration checklist.
Maya (docs): Done. Ran the preview build.
link-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-3472--docs.redwood.ai/optimize/migration (status: linkcheck failed: /benchmarks/long-kv-cache)

Juno (devex): After fix, can someone run the smoke test against staging and paste sample output (sanitized)? I want to include a non-PII sample row.
Ravi (eng-opt): Ran smoke against fast-llama-staging: output = "Summary: key points..." No stack traces. Command used: `./scripts/eval_profiles --profile q4_0 --samples 100 --staging`
Maya (docs): Added smoke note to PR description and included the sanitized sample. Marking ready for review.
Juno (devex): Style nit: prefer backticks for CLI commands in copy. Small lint fix incoming.
Sven (runtime): Technical LGTM once the "server hint" wording is added to SDK note.
